blockingIssues.description: The knowledge-import acceptance criteria explicitly include reading build.zig.zon for Zig 0.16 alignment after importing context, but build.zig.zon still declares `.minimum_zig_version = "0.15.2"`. This leaves the imported Zig 0.16 guidance misaligned with repo-facing toolchain metadata, so the feature does not fully satisfy its expected behavior as reviewed from the committed diff.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Split the validator guidance so knowledge-import-only tasks may record unrelated baseline Zig 0.16 build/test failures without being told to rerun the repo hard gate after each edit cluster.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Transcript handoff skillFeedback.followedProcedure=false with deviations for the hard-gate step, while the feature description explicitly says unrelated Zig 0.16 runtime/build blockers should be surfaced but left for the baseline runtime feature.
